name: Berserker curse: quiet
desc: The armor's influence is still faint.  Remove all pieces to let it fade; resting without the armor speeds recovery.

name: Berserker curse: whispers
desc: The armor's whispers grow louder.  Remove all pieces to recover; resting without the armor is faster.

name: Berserker curse: visions
desc: Unsettling visions distract you.  Perception -1.  Remove all pieces to recover; resting without the armor is faster.

name: Berserker curse: breaking point
desc: The armor's influence overwhelms your senses.  Perception -2.  Remove all pieces to recover; resting without the armor is faster.
